name: hybrid
rationale: M5-04 fourth cost candidate (record 117 option A), restated on top of the released retrieval bundle (policy 3361ed13): only the answer-context layout changes, off -> sentfocus-v6 = the sentfocus-v2 sentence selection (two-sided neighbours, first chunk whole, question + richest rewritten query) with short block delimiters and one legend line giving each document's version once instead of once per block. Nothing is removed beyond what v2 removed. Measured so far: v2 pilot -22.7% real tokens at +4.0 pp with no slice drop (record 116); v5 pilot -26.6% but the one-sided neighbours cost the negation slice 4.4 pp (record 117); v6 offline 28.0% with 99.6% of the annotated answer texts kept (proxy tokenizer; within 0.1-0.3 pp of the provider's count in both pilots). Cost gate: tokens per main item <= 75% of baseline, overall success drop <= 1 pp, slice and safety rules unchanged.
